notesEn:
The live keeps streaming when you minimize the app — it no longer exits
Fixed: the app preview no longer goes black when the live starts
New: Mute phone sound option for video file and link lives — only your phone goes quiet, the live sound stays on
Coming back to the app restores the live preview
